UpdateSourceArgs:
-c "DotnetVersion=\"{{DotnetVersion}}\"
FALLBACK_VERSION=\"10.0.10\"
cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\" || exit 1
if [[ -x dotnet/dotnet ]]; then
  InstalledVersion=$(dotnet/dotnet --list-runtimes | sed -n 's/^Microsoft\\.AspNetCore\\.App \\([0-9.]*\\) .*/\\1/p' | head -n1)
else
  InstalledVersion=\"\"
fi
if [[ -z \"$DotnetVersion\" ]]; then
  RawResponse=$(wget -qO- --header=\"User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AMP-Tarkov-Template\" --tries=3 --timeout=15 https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/10.0/releases.json 2>/tmp/dotnet_wget_err)
  DotnetVersion=$(echo \"$RawResponse\" | jq -r '.\"latest-runtime\" // empty' 2>/dev/null)
  if [[ -z \"$DotnetVersion\" || ! \"$DotnetVersion\" =~ ^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    echo \"Warning: could not resolve the latest .NET 10 runtime version from builds.dotnet.microsoft.com\"
    echo \"wget stderr: $(cat /tmp/dotnet_wget_err 2>/dev/null)\"
    echo \"Response received (first 200 chars): $(echo \"$RawResponse\" | head -c 200)\"
    echo \"Falling back to pinned known-good version $FALLBACK_VERSION\"
    DotnetVersion=\"$FALLBACK_VERSION\"
  fi
fi
if [[ ! \"$DotnetVersion\" =~ ^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo \"Invalid ASP.NET Core Runtime version format specified: '$DotnetVersion'\"
  echo \"Set the 'Dotnet Version' field in the app config to a specific version like $FALLBACK_VERSION and update again\"
  exit 1
elif [[ \"$InstalledVersion\" == \"$DotnetVersion\" ]]; then
  echo \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion already installed. Skipping\"
  exit 0
else
  [[ -f dotnet.tar.gz ]] && rm -f dotnet.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1
  wget -qO dotnet.tar.gz --tries=3 --timeout=30 \"https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/Runtime/$DotnetVersion/aspnetcore-runtime-$DotnetVersion-linux-x64.tar.gz\" || { echo \"Download failed from the Microsoft CDN for version $DotnetVersion. This is a fault with the CDN or the specified version, not AMP. Aborting\"; exit 1; }
  rm -rf dotnet/* >/dev/null 2>&1
  tar -xzf dotnet.tar.gz -C dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1
  rm -f dotnet.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1
  echo \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion downloaded\"
fi
"

-c "cd tarkov/7-Zip || exit 1
if [[ -x 7zzs ]]; then
  exit 0
else
  wget -qO 7z.tar.xz https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7z2600-linux-x64.tar.xz && tar -xf 7z.tar.xz >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f 7z.tar.xz >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
"

-c "cd tarkov/server || exit 1
[[ -d SPT.bak ]] && rm -rf SPT.bak >/dev/null 2>&1
if [[ -d SPT ]]; then
  \\cp -rf SPT SPT.bak >/dev/null 2>&1
else
  exit 0
fi
"

-c "cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\" || exit 1
VERSION_PATTERN='^4\\.1\\.[0-9]+$'
UA=\"Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AMP-Tarkov-Template\"
fetch_url() {
  org=\"$1\"
  wget -qO- --header=\"User-Agent: $UA\" --tries=3 --timeout=15 \"https://api.github.com/repos/${org}/build/releases?per_page=30\" 2>/dev/null \\
    | jq -r --arg pat \"$VERSION_PATTERN\" '[.[] | select((.tag_name|test($pat)) and (.draft|not))] | sort_by(.created_at) | reverse | .[0].body // empty' 2>/dev/null \\
    | grep -Eo 'https://[^ ]+\\.7z' \\
    | head -n1
}
DownloadURL=$(fetch_url \"SP-Tushonka\")
if [[ -z \"$DownloadURL\" ]]; then
  echo \"No 4.1.x release found on SP-Tushonka/build yet, trying sp-tarkov/build\"
  DownloadURL=$(fetch_url \"sp-tarkov\")
fi
if [[ -z \"$DownloadURL\" ]]; then
  echo \"ERROR: could not resolve a 4.1.x SPT download URL from SP-Tushonka/build or sp-tarkov/build.\"
  echo \"This is usually the unauthenticated GitHub API rate limit (60 requests/hour/IP) - wait a while and update again,\"
  echo \"or check https://github.com/SP-Tushonka/build/releases and https://github.com/sp-tarkov/build/releases manually.\"
  exit 1
fi
echo \"Resolved SPT 4.1.x download URL: $DownloadURL\"
cd tarkov/server || exit 1
rm -f SPT.7z
wget -qO SPT.7z --header=\"User-Agent: $UA\" --tries=3 --timeout=60 \"$DownloadURL\" || { echo \"Download of SPT archive failed\"; exit 1; }
rm -rf SPT_extract_tmp
mkdir -p SPT_extract_tmp
../7-Zip/7zzs x -y -aoa SPT.7z -oSPT_extract_tmp >/dev/null 2>&1
rm -f SPT.7z
SRC_DIR=$(find SPT_extract_tmp -maxdepth 3 -type d -name SPT_Data -exec dirname {} \\; | head -n1)
if [[ -z \"$SRC_DIR\" ]]; then
  echo \"ERROR: could not find an SPT_Data folder inside the downloaded archive - the release layout may have changed upstream.\"
  rm -rf SPT_extract_tmp
  exit 1
fi
rm -rf SPT
mv \"$SRC_DIR\" SPT
rm -rf SPT_extract_tmp
chmod +x SPT/SPT.Server.Linux 2>/dev/null
echo \"SPT installation complete\"
"
